numeric.name: driver_age
numeric.description: Age of the primary driver in years; strong non-linear risk factor with higher risk at young and very old ages.

numeric.name: vehicle_age
numeric.description: Age of the insured vehicle in years; older vehicles typically have lower values but higher mechanical failure risk.
numeric.data_quality_note: Max of 68 years is plausible for classic vehicles but worth monitoring for data entry errors.

numeric.name: age_driving_licence
numeric.description: Number of years the driver has held a licence; proxy for driving experience, inversely related to risk.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0 may indicate newly licensed drivers; correlated with driver_age so interaction effects should be monitored.

numeric.name: vehicle_value
numeric.description: Market or insured value of the vehicle; key driver of comprehensive and property damage premium components.
numeric.data_quality_note: 0.14% nulls require imputation; max of ~374k suggests high-value outliers that may need capping or log transformation.

numeric.name: power_to_weight_ratio
numeric.description: Vehicle power relative to weight; proxy for vehicle performance and associated accident severity risk.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0 may indicate missing or erroneous entries; distribution should be checked.

numeric.name: seats
numeric.description: Number of seats in the vehicle; proxy for vehicle size/type and potential occupant exposure.

numeric.name: liability_exposure
numeric.description: Fractional exposure period for liability coverage; accounts for mid-term policy changes affecting earned exposure.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0.0027 indicates very short-term policies; may introduce noise for near-zero exposures.

categorical.name: policy_type
categorical.description: Type of motor insurance policy (e.g. comprehensive, third-party); directly determines coverage scope and premium level.

categorical.name: business_type
categorical.description: Indicates whether the policy is new business (NB) or renewal/portfolio transfer (P); renewal business typically exhibits lower risk due to selection effects.

categorical.name: payment_frequency
categorical.description: Frequency of premium payment (Annual, Semi-annual, Quarterly); associated with policyholder financial behaviour and lapse risk.

categorical.name: bonus_score
categorical.description: Bonus-malus or behavioural score category (Good, Neutral, Bad); reflects historical claims behaviour and is a strong risk predictor.

categorical.name: fuel_type
categorical.description: Fuel type of the vehicle (Diesel or Gasoline); associated with vehicle usage patterns, mileage, and risk profile.
categorical.data_quality_note: 0.36% nulls; may require an 'Unknown' category or imputation based on vehicle characteristics.

categorical.name: vehicle_brand
categorical.description: Manufacturer brand of the insured vehicle; proxy for vehicle quality, repair costs, theft attractiveness, and driver demographics.
categorical.data_quality_note: 68 unique brands with long tail; low-frequency brands should be grouped to avoid overfitting.

categorical.name: municipality_type
categorical.description: Classification of the municipality where the vehicle is registered (Intermediate, Capital, Island/Special); reflects urban density and traffic risk.

categorical.name: circulation_area
categorical.description: Urban or rural circulation area of the vehicle; urban areas associated with higher frequency of minor accidents, rural with higher severity.
